## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets the `main` branch.
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits. A breaking change has `!` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.
- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] A change to an option, a default or an export also updates the READMEs, the consumer skills and the examples.
